faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT Delhi) for research positions in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) under research field focusing on ESDM and IT/ ITES domains.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) post at IIIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IIIT Delhi Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as per the guidelines specified in the official notification details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1,08,393/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to IIIT Delhi?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form for this post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the online application link provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online links?
faq.answer: You can find all necessary links, including the official notification PDF and online application portal, in the Important Links section above.
